description: Default permissions for the Forage Buddy Android app. Note: tauri-plugin-edge-to-edge is deliberately absent - its published permission set is broken (references a nonexistent command) and its CSS-variable injection is automatic, needing no permissions. No camera permission either: photo capture uses a plain HTML <input type="file" capture> element, which Android's webview hands off to the system camera app via an intent - that needs no permission grant from this app.
